mapper.select: SELECT DATE(create_time) AS analysis_date, ROUND(AVG(overall_score), 2) AS avg_overall_score, ROUND(AVG(stability_score), 2) AS avg_stability_score, ROUND(AVG(fluency_score), 2) AS avg_fluency_score, ROUND(AVG(proficiency_score), 2) AS avg_proficiency_score FROM ai_analysis_result WHERE create_by = #{createBy} AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY analysis_date

SELECT type, COUNT(*) AS total_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN send_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) THEN 1 END) AS last_30_days_count FROM ai_content_info WHERE create_by = #{createBy} AND type IN ('card', 'text') GROUP BY type

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN send_time >= CURDATE() THEN 1 END) AS todayCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN send_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) THEN 1 END) AS last30DaysCount FROM ai_content_info WHERE create_by = #{createBy} AND type = 'card'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN a.create_time >= CURDATE() THEN 1 END) AS todayCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN a.create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) THEN 1 END) AS last30DaysCount FROM ai_note_info a LEFT JOIN sys_file f ON a.video_id = f.id WHERE a.deleted IS FALSE AND (a.course_id IS NULL OR a.course_id = '') AND a.title IS NOT NULL AND a.title != '' AND a.create_by = #{createBy}
